parameter_semantics: target_object and context_object select observed poses transformed into the measured TCP frame; destination_goal selects the observed point transformed into that frame. Learned translations are metres and rotation vectors are radians in each slot's measured pre-action TCP frame. Training binds blue, blue_goal and red.
output_semantics: Each slot is [local dx,dy,dz metres, local rotation-vector rx,ry,rz radians, gripper], a target transform from that slot's measured pre-action TCP. Slots align to t-1 through t+14 and execution uses 1..8. At each actual execution step decode_action composes the represented transform with the freshly measured current TCP; transforms are not accumulated from predicted history. It then invokes panda_kinematics.solve_ik from fresh qpos and appends the native gripper scalar.

conversion_check.description: For each supervised slot, inverse(measured pre-action TCP) times command FK pose and subsequent composition exactly recover the command world target up to rotation-log numerical precision. The independent check compares world TCP pose and gripper while allowing nonunique IK.

cut_relation: The complete twelve assigned slices are supervised, including predecessor final red release through blue lift and successor blue placement through buffered-red closure/lift. Fresh-TCP conversion changes only action coordinates and preserves success and overlap.
